    • addAdministrator

      void addAdministrator(AdministrationNode administrator)

      Adds an AdministrationNode for this OfficeManagedObjectType.

      This allows the OfficeManagedObjectType to report the extension types required to be supported by the OfficeFloorManagedObject for the OfficeObject.

      Parameters:
      administrator - AdministrationNode.

    • addGovernance

      void addGovernance(GovernanceNode governance)

      Adds a GovernanceNode providing Governance for this OfficeObject.

      This also allows the OfficeManagedObjectType to report the extension interfaces required to be supported by the OfficeFloorManagedObject for the OfficeObject.

      Parameters:
      governance - GovernanceNode.
